name: Termination — access revocation
direction: hris -> okta -> downstream fan-out (github, gcp, slack)
trigger: termination event recorded in the HRIS

population_templates.name: Terminated workers
population_templates.definition: Every worker (employee or contractor) whose engagement ended during the period, as enumerated by the {hris} termination feed
population_templates.rule_text: all members enumerated by authoritative source {hris}-termination-feed; {okta}-system-log deactivation events corroborate membership

population_templates.name: {system} accounts
population_templates.definition: Every account able to authenticate to {system} — SSO-provisioned and local (non-SSO) accounts alike — including access derived from group membership
population_templates.rule_text: all accounts enumerated by {system}-account-inventory, joined with group-derived access from {okta}-group-assignments

population_templates.name: Terminated worker to downstream accounts
population_templates.definition: Canonical-identity join of every terminated worker to every downstream account attributable to them across the lane's target systems
population_templates.rule_text: canonical-identity join of {hris}-termination-feed members to each downstream system's account inventory, keyed through {okta}-system-log identities

claim_templates.statement: Every termination recorded in the HRIS enters the deprovisioning queue — the population control everything downstream depends on

assertions.predicate_text: termination-feed membership reconciles set-wise against the HR-reported termination population for the period, with zero undispositioned deltas
every termination in the feed has a corresponding deprovisioning event in the identity provider

claim_templates.statement: Every terminated worker lost access within five business days of the termination date

assertions.predicate_text: identity-provider deactivation occurred no more than five business days after the termination date, tested across the full population

claim_templates.statement: Every downstream account or access-holding identity on the lane is attributable through the canonical identity join to a worker the authoritative source accounts for — negative space is surfaced, never absorbed

assertions.predicate_text: the canonical-identity join across the lane's declared sources resolves with zero undispositioned deltas; identities present in contributing sources but absent from the authoritative source are first-class deltas, never silently dropped

claim_templates.statement: No terminated worker retains an active {system} account or group-derived access after revocation

assertions.predicate_text: no active {system} account — SSO-provisioned, local, or reachable through group membership — exists for any terminated worker
